risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's nameplate (usually on the back or side).

risks.risk: The compressor may be failing or the thermostat may be faulty despite the presence of frost.
risks.proof: A video of the compressor running and a photo of a thermometer inside the unit showing a sub-zero temperature.

risks.risk: The actual capacity may be lower than claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the technical specification plate showing the volume in liters.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the technical nameplate/sticker on the back or side of the freezer.
A clear, close-up photo of the brand logo on the front.
A video of the freezer plugged in and running, showing the interior temperature.
response.reason: The brand and capacity are critical for pricing this appliance, and neither can be confirmed from the current photos. The logo is too blurry to read.
